items.title: Safer and healthier workplaces can help tackle labour shortages
items.lead: Labour shortages persist across many occupations that are essential to Europe’s economy and its green and digital transitions. Cedefop and EU-OSHA highlight an important part of the solution: improving job quality, including occupational safety and health (OSH).

items.title: Behind the screen: protecting the mental health of online content reviewers
items.lead: Online content reviewers help keep digital spaces safer, but the work can come at a high psychological cost. Repeated exposure to disturbing content, combined with intense workloads, algorithmic monitoring and precarious working conditions, can increase the risk of stress, burnout and trauma-related symptoms.
